patho.caption_source: 68Ga-PSMA ligand PET/CT in a 78-year old patient with primary PC (Gleason score 7, iPSA 34.3 ng/ml). The CT examination with bone window setting (a) shows osteoblastic bone lesions in the left iliac bone as well as in the thoracic vertebrae with corresponding PSMA-ligand uptake in PET imaging (b). Note the physiological high uptake in the kidneys as well as moderate uptake in the liver and spleen
